description: Marks a suggestion or comment as discarded; the page HTML is not modified. Owner only. Useful for stale suggestions (409 anchor_not_found). Returns { ok, comment } with third-party comment text in untrustedText.

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner (default: the connected account). Owner only
